objective: Extend the BR-01 finding detail with a visible test-gap section and a 'Generate Guardrail Test' action that reveals a fixture-driven JUnit 5 characterization test capturing the current RoundingMode.DOWN behavior so any future regression is detected explicitly.

requirements.description: The FindingDetail view inside FindingsPane must display a 'Test Gap' section below the test-coverage block when finding.testCoverage === 'uncovered', containing a gap explanation, existing test evidence, and a 'Generate Guardrail Test' button.

Create lib/analysis/fixtures/meridian-sample-guardrail-test.json as a development fixture with a _fixture_note field, containing: id, behavior_rule_id ('BR-01'), analysis_id, filename, framework, language, code (valid JUnit 5 Java for the 1500.00/0.00823/12.345→12.34 scenario), rationale, status, protected_behavior, boundary_scenario (balance/rate/raw_fee/current_result/proposed_result as strings), and detection_note.

Create lib/analysis/guardrail-test.ts with GuardrailTestSchema (camelCase Zod domain), GuardrailTestWireSchema (snake_case, .passthrough()), and guardrailTestFromWireFormat(wire) mapper. Include a SEC-001 comment on the mapper. The 'status' field must use z.literal("generated") so Feature 6 can widen it to z.enum([...]) without breaking existing validated data.

Extend lib/review-workspace/loader.ts to import meridian-sample-guardrail-test.json, parse it through GuardrailTestWireSchema, map via guardrailTestFromWireFormat, and add guardrailTest: GuardrailTest to the MeridianReviewSession interface and return value.
app/page.tsx must destructure guardrailTest from getMeridianReviewSession() and pass it as guardrailTest={guardrailTest} to FindingsPane.
FindingsPane must accept an optional guardrailTest?: GuardrailTest prop. When absent, the component renders identically to its Feature 4 state.

When testCoverage === 'uncovered' and guardrailTest is provided and guardrailTest.behaviorRuleId appears in finding.behaviorRuleIds, the Test Gap section must render a 'TEST GAP' header, the precise claim 'No existing test distinguishes the current DOWN behavior from HALF_UP for BR-01', and a 'Generate Guardrail Test' button.

Clicking 'Generate Guardrail Test' triggers a two-stage deterministic transition using local React state and setTimeout: stage 1 shows 'Preparing characterization test…' immediately, stage 2 shows 'Building boundary scenario…' after 450 ms, and the GuardrailTestView renders after 900 ms total. No fake token streaming. Both setTimeout handles must be cancelled in a useEffect cleanup function to prevent state updates on unmounted components.

Create app/components/GuardrailTestView.tsx as a Client Component accepting guardrailTest: GuardrailTest. It must display: filename header, coverage target (behaviorRuleId pill + protectedBehavior), boundary scenario block (balance/rate/rawFee/currentResult/proposedResult), behavior baseline showing 12.345→12.34 (DOWN) vs 12.345→12.35 (HALF_UP) with detectionNote, read-only Java code block, rationale, and a FIXTURE-DRIVEN status badge. No hardcoded Java in JSX.

The copy button in GuardrailTestView calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(guardrailTest.code), toggles its label to 'Copied' for 2 seconds on success, and silently catches errors if the clipboard API is unavailable.
The UI must not display 'Test passed' or 'Test failed'. The detection note section must be labeled 'Expected detection'. No Maven invocation occurs.

All new UI must use the established Legacy Lens design tokens (--surface-*, --border-*, --text-*, --risk-*). No gradients, no animation libraries, no emojis, no AI sparkle effects. GuardrailTestView is rendered inline below the Test Gap section using the same max-height CSS transition pattern as IntentPanel.

The fixture meridian-sample-guardrail-test.json must contain syntactically plausible JUnit 5 Java code using @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class), mirroring LateFeeServiceTest conventions, with the 1500.00 balance/0.00823 rate scenario, asserting assertEquals(new BigDecimal("12.34"), lateFeeCharged, ...).

Data flow: JSON fixture → GuardrailTestWireSchema.parse() in loader.ts → guardrailTestFromWireFormat() → GuardrailTest domain type → FindingsPane → GuardrailTestView. No raw JSON may reach any UI component.

The implementation must be structured so Feature 6 can replace the fixture import in loader.ts with real Bob output without modifying UI components — GuardrailTestWireSchema and the domain type must remain as the stable interface.

non_requirements: No real IBM Bob API invocation or live analysis pipeline.
No modification of demo/legacy-billing/** (frozen fixture must remain untouched).
No adding the characterization test to demo/legacy-billing/src/test/**.
No Maven execution from the UI.
No code editor widget — read-only display only.
No Behavior Map or blast-radius visualization.
No GitHub integration, database, or authentication.
No fake token streaming or fake AI progress beyond the two-message transition.
Do not display 'Test passed' or 'Test failed'.
No redesign of DiffPane, ReviewHeader, or IntentPanel.
Do not modify lib/analysis/types.ts, parser.ts, review.ts, intent.ts, blast-radius.ts, or metadata.ts.
Do not modify any existing fixture JSON files.

test_requirements.description: GuardrailTestWireSchema.safeParse passes on a valid wire object with all required fields.
GuardrailTestWireSchema.safeParse fails when behavior_rule_id is missing.
guardrailTestFromWireFormat maps behavior_rule_id to behaviorRuleId and all other snake_case fields to camelCase correctly.
getMeridianReviewSession() returns a guardrailTest object with behaviorRuleId === 'BR-01'.
FindingsPane with a finding having testCoverage 'uncovered' and guardrailTest provided renders text matching 'TEST GAP'.
FindingsPane renders a 'Generate Guardrail Test' button when guardrailTest is provided and testCoverage is 'uncovered'.
Clicking 'Generate Guardrail Test' renders a transitional message containing 'Preparing characterization test'.
After fake timers advance past 900 ms, GuardrailTestView is rendered in the DOM.
GuardrailTestView code block contains '1500.00' (canonical balance scenario).
GuardrailTestView code block contains '12.34' (the asserted current behavior).
GuardrailTestView does not render any text matching 'Test passed' or 'Test failed'.

security_requirements.description: guardrailTest data must flow through GuardrailTestWireSchema.parse() in loader.ts before reaching any UI component — no raw fixture JSON may reach the React tree.
GuardrailTestView must render only typed GuardrailTest domain model fields using standard JSX string interpolation — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no eval, no raw JSON rendering.
The copy button must use navigator.clipboard.writeText only; errors must be silently caught; no unintended side effects or data exfiltration.
No external URLs, network I/O, fetch calls, or API routes are introduced by this feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: npm test exits 0: all prior tests TEST-001 through TEST-308 still pass, and new tests TEST-401 through TEST-414 all pass.
npm run lint exits 0 with no new ESLint errors or warnings.
tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
npm run build exits 0 (Turbopack build succeeds).
When the BR-01 / F-001 finding is selected, the finding detail shows a 'TEST GAP' section and a 'Generate Guardrail Test' button visible without horizontal scrolling at 1280px viewport.
Clicking 'Generate Guardrail Test' shows at least one transitional message ('Preparing characterization test…') before the test view appears.
After the transition, the generated test view shows 'LateFeeRoundingCharacterizationTest.java' as the filename.
The generated test code block contains 'balance=1500.00', '0.00823', '12.345', and '12.34'.
The generated test view shows proposed behavior '12.35' and a detection note explaining what the test would catch.
The UI does not display 'Test passed' or 'Test failed' anywhere in the generated test view.
The generated test view contains a 'FIXTURE-DRIVEN' or equivalent badge indicating the artifact is not live Bob output.
The existing 'Reveal Intent' interaction on F-001 remains functional after this feature is implemented.
DiffPane and ReviewHeader remain visually unchanged.
git diff --name-only shows no changes to demo/legacy-billing/**.
loader.ts contains GuardrailTestWireSchema.parse() applied to the guardrail test fixture before any field is accessed (verifiable by code inspection).
GuardrailTestView.tsx contains no dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage (verifiable by grep).
